title: Claude Code OpenTelemetry metrics, spans, and events (Claude Code 2.1.307)
$comment: For the OpenTelemetry data Claude Code emits. Each $defs entry is one metric, span, or event; the kind is in x-otel-kind and the properties are its attributes. Generated from Claude Code 2.1.307 by tools/schemas/code.ts. Anchors: "Count of CLI sessions started" (the meter setup that registers each metric with its description and unit) with the counter accessor functions and their .add(value, attributes) call sites; the span helpers (startSpan("claude_code.<name>") with the attribute literal built just before it, and the wrapper that takes {spanType, attrs, contentAttrs}); the event emitter that sets "event.name", "event.timestamp", "event.sequence" and its call sites with the attribute literal; the base attribute builder behind "OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID". No probe in captures/ records telemetry, so nothing is marked x-observed. Do not edit by hand.
